notice: Discovery worklist only, not clinical evidence. No sources or snippets have been appraised or supplied. Generator evidence preflight must fail until full-text review, rights verification, exact locators, objective mapping and faculty review are completed.

discovery_queries.objective: Classify esotropia, exotropia, vertical and paralytic deviations
Assess amblyopia, suppression, stereopsis and binocular vision
Describe treatment principles including refractive correction, occlusion and surgery

preferred_source_families: Current AAO PPP/BCSC or relevant national/international guidance
Cochrane Eyes and Vision; PubMed/PMC/Europe PMC systematic reviews and primary studies
AAO EyeWiki and peer-reviewed specialty reviews for orientation, not sole guideline authority
AnkiWeb, DoctorDE, Geeky Medics and TeachMeSeries as exam-practice signals only; never clinical evidence
curator_checklist: Verify exact source, edition, date, jurisdiction and supersession status.
Review full text through a lawful access path and record article-specific reuse rights.
Add concise independently authored evidence notes or permitted excerpts with exact page/section/paragraph locators.
Map each snippet to the exact objective ID above.
Obtain qualified ophthalmology faculty review; never change status fields merely to bypass preflight.
